name: Tea Bowl with Indented Lip and Russet Hare's-Fur Markings
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；12th-13th century；Jian ware: dark gray stoneware with dark brown glaze, the markings in iron oxide, the base with an incised inscription reading 'Gongyu'.  From the kilns at Shuiji, Jianyang county, Fujian province, probably from those at Luhuaping or Chidun.
